candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get fever, and fever don dey for 2 days. Im temperature na 38.0°C. Fever get obvious cause. No sign say pikin dey convulse now, and dem never get convulsion before. Pikin no dey lethargic and im dey conscious. E fit drink or breastfeed. E no dey vomit everything. Dem no find generalized rash. No identified bacterial cause for this fever. Malaria risk dey low. Pikin no get cough or difficult breathing. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get red eyes. E no get runny nose. E no get stiff neck. Dem no see sign say e cough for measles. Dem no get history of measles within last 3 months.
